استهدفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَهْدَفُوا (istahdafū) /is.tah.da.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَهْدَفَ (istahdafa)
# اُسْتُهْدِفُوا (ustuhdifū) /us.tuh.di.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَهْدَفَ (istahdafa)
# اِسْتَهْدِفُوا (istahdifū) /is.tah.di.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَهْدَفَ (istahdafa)
